fold:meta.title: Flapping bird
fold:meta.blurb: Pull its tail and the wings beat. Your first petal folds, without the crane’s fine finish.

fold:steps.title: Fold in half and unfold
fold:steps.text: Fold the paper in half edge to edge, then open it again.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you, crease firmly, then unfold

fold:steps.title: Fold in half the other way
fold:steps.text: Fold in half the other way, edge to edge, and unfold.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you, crease firmly, then unfold

fold:steps.title: Turn over
fold:steps.text: Turn the paper over so the colour faces up.
fold:steps.tip: flip the whole model so the back faces you

fold:steps.title: Fold corner to corner
fold:steps.text: Fold the bottom corner up to the top corner, then unfold.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you, crease firmly, then unfold

fold:steps.title: Fold the other diagonal
fold:steps.text: Fold the left corner to the right corner, then unfold.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you, crease firmly, then unfold

fold:steps.title: Collapse into a square base
fold:steps.text: Bring the side corners down to the bottom corner and flatten into a small square.
fold:steps.tip: let the paper fold along creases you already made

fold:steps.title: Fold the right edge to the centre
fold:steps.text: Fold the lower right edge of the top layer to the centre line.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you so the edge lies on the centre line

fold:steps.title: Fold the left edge to the centre
fold:steps.text: Fold the lower left edge of the top layer to the centre line.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you so the edge lies on the centre line

fold:steps.title: Fold the top down
fold:steps.text: Fold the top triangle down over the flaps and crease firmly.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you along the top of the side flaps

fold:steps.title: Unfold the three folds
fold:steps.text: Unfold the top triangle and the two side flaps.
fold:steps.tip: open the last three folds; the creases stay

fold:steps.title: Petal fold
fold:steps.text: Lift the bottom corner of the top layer up and let the sides fold in to the centre.
fold:steps.tip: lift one layer and let its sides fold in along creases

fold:steps.title: Turn over
fold:steps.text: Turn the paper over from side to side.
fold:steps.tip: flip the whole model so the back faces you

fold:steps.title: Petal fold the back
fold:steps.text: Repeat the petal fold on this side: lift the bottom corner and fold the sides in.
fold:steps.tip: lift one layer and let its sides fold in along creases

fold:steps.title: Reverse fold the neck
fold:steps.text: Fold the right lower point up inside the body, close to the wing.
fold:steps.tip: open the layers and push the point up between them

fold:steps.title: Reverse fold the tail
fold:steps.text: Fold the left lower point up inside the body the same way.
fold:steps.tip: open the layers and push the point up between them

fold:steps.title: Reverse fold the head
fold:steps.text: Fold the tip of the neck down inside itself to make the head.
fold:steps.tip: open the layers and push the point up between them

fold:steps.title: Fold the wings down
fold:steps.text: Fold the front wing down along the top of the body, and the back wing behind.
fold:steps.tip: fold one wing toward you and the other away

fold:steps.title: Shape the wings
fold:steps.text: Stand the bird up and curve the wings out. Hold the neck and pull the tail to flap.
fold:steps.tip: the last touch: bend flaps to give the model its form

fold:step.text: Fold the paper in half edge to edge, then open it again.

file_frames.frame_title: Fold in half the other way

fold:step.text: Fold in half the other way, edge to edge, and unfold.
Turn the paper over so the colour faces up.
Fold the bottom corner up to the top corner, then unfold.
Fold the left corner to the right corner, then unfold.
Bring the side corners down to the bottom corner and flatten into a small square.

file_frames.frame_title: Fold the right edge to the centre

fold:step.text: Fold the lower right edge of the top layer to the centre line.

file_frames.frame_title: Fold the left edge to the centre

fold:step.text: Fold the lower left edge of the top layer to the centre line.
Fold the top triangle down over the flaps and crease firmly.
Unfold the top triangle and the two side flaps.
Lift the bottom corner of the top layer up and let the sides fold in to the centre.
Turn the paper over from side to side.
Repeat the petal fold on this side: lift the bottom corner and fold the sides in.
Fold the right lower point up inside the body, close to the wing.
Fold the left lower point up inside the body the same way.
Fold the tip of the neck down inside itself to make the head.
Fold the front wing down along the top of the body, and the back wing behind.
Stand the bird up and curve the wings out. Hold the neck and pull the tail to flap.
